name: The Cure

whyMatters.en: Crawley band that moved from post-punk minimalism to goth and then mainstream goth-pop; Disintegration (1989) and Kiss Me–era singles mark the arc.
whyMatters.zh: 克劳利乐队：从后朋克极简走到哥特再进主流哥特流行；Disintegration（1989）与 Kiss Me 时期单曲标记弧线。

note.en: Delay-guitar cold wave; early Cure minimalism.
note.zh: Delay 吉他冷潮；早期 Cure 极简。

note.en: Kiss Me–era bright single; chorus guitar hook.
note.zh: Kiss Me 时期明亮单曲；chorus 吉他钩子。

note.en: Disintegration long-form gloom at stadium scale.
note.zh: Disintegration 体育场体量的长篇阴郁。

interviewQuotes.text: I think of the Cure as a continuum.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Robert Smith

lyricQuotes: Show me how you do it and I promise you / I promise that I'll run away with you
Whenever I'm alone with you / You make me feel like I am home again

shortBio.en: Robert Smith–led post-punk/goth-pop; Just Like Heaven is the bright single; Disintegration the long gloom.
shortBio.zh: Robert Smith 领衔的后朋克/哥特流行；Just Like Heaven 是明亮单曲；Disintegration 是长篇阴郁。

body.en:
Formed 1978. Three Imaginary Boys and Pornography define cold early sound; The Head on the Door and Kiss Me add pop hooks; Disintegration returns long-form gloom at scale.

Constants: Smith’s chorus guitar, extended song lengths, fan culture across indie and goth clubs.
body.zh:
1978 年组建。Three Imaginary Boys 与 Pornography 定义早期冷声；The Head on the Door 与 Kiss Me 加入流行钩子；Disintegration 以体量回到长篇阴郁。

常量：Smith 的 chorus 吉他、偏长歌曲、跨 indie 与哥特俱乐部的粉丝文化。

title.en: From post-punk cold to goth-pop radio
title.zh: 从后朋克冷声到哥特流行电台

body.en:
Early Cure: short lines, delay, hollow drums. Mid-80s: hooks without dropping the baritone croon. 1989 Disintegration: six-minute songs, cathedral reverb, stadium gloom.

Arc is production and song length, not a costume change only.
body.zh:
早期 Cure：短句、delay、空鼓。80 年代中：钩子不丢男中音 croon。1989 Disintegration：六分钟歌、教堂混响、体育场阴郁。

弧线是制作与歌曲长度，不只是换装。

body.en:
Gallup exits and returns; Tolhurst shifts drums→keys then leaves; Thompson/Williams lock Kiss Me–Disintegration peak cast.

Peak flag: late-80s six-piece studio core around Smith. Logo survives because writing seat does not move.
body.zh:
Gallup 离队再回归；Tolhurst 从鼓转键盘再离开；Thompson/Williams 锁死 Kiss Me–Disintegration 巅峰卡司。

巅峰旗：80 年代末围绕 Smith 的六人录音核心。Logo 存活因为写作席位不动。

title.en: Chorus guitar, Gallup bass, rotating kit
title.zh: Chorus 吉他、Gallup 贝斯、轮换鼓组

body.en:
Smith: Jazzmaster/Jaguar + chorus/delay, lipstick visual. Gallup: melodic post-punk bass. Tolhurst then Williams on kit. Thompson adds lead color on pop singles.

Personnel list is long; sound ID is short: Smith’s guitar+voice.
body.zh:
Smith：Jazzmaster/Jaguar + chorus/delay，唇膏视觉。Gallup：旋律后朋克贝斯。Tolhurst 然后 Williams 司鼓。Thompson 在流行单曲上加主音色彩。

人事名单很长；声音 ID 很短：Smith 的吉他+人声。

body.en:
Seventeen Seconds-era. Repeating guitar figure, dry vocal, bass that walks not thumps. Club-era post-punk grammar.

Entry for listeners who start from goth-pop singles and walk backward.
body.zh:
Seventeen Seconds 时期。重复吉他音型、干人声、走动而非砸击的贝斯。俱乐部时期后朋克语法。

从哥特流行单曲倒走的听众入口。

title.en: Just Like Heaven: bright without soft

body.en:
Kiss Me, Kiss Me, Kiss Me single. Major-key hook, still chorus-soaked guitar. US college radio crossover without abandoning Smith’s diction.

Mass entry that still points back to darker albums.
body.zh:
Kiss Me, Kiss Me, Kiss Me 单曲。大调钩子，仍是 chorus 浸透吉他。美国大学电台跨界，不丢 Smith 咬字。

仍指向更暗专辑的大众入口。

title.zh: Alternative 电台的哥特流行模板

body.en:
Disintegration becomes the long-album citation. Later alternative and goth-club DJs both pull Cure singles. Influence sits beside Joy Division/New Order on UK post-punk family tree.

Chronicle: one writer’s guitar tone across three commercial climates.
body.zh:
Disintegration 成为长专引用。后来 alternative 与哥特俱乐部 DJ 都抽 Cure 单曲。影响坐在 Joy Division/New Order 旁的英国后朋克族谱上。

编年史：一个写作者的吉他音色跨三种商业气候。

note.zh: 流行单曲然后体育场阴郁。

note.en: Seventeen Seconds / Faith / Pornography cold era.
note.zh: Seventeen Seconds / Faith / Pornography 冷声期。

note.en: Delay-led post-punk single that fixed early Cure ID.
note.zh: 用 delay 固定早期 Cure ID 的后朋克单曲。

note.en: Post-punk to goth-pop continuum under one songwriter.
note.zh: 单一写作者下的后朋克到哥特流行连续体。
